reviewed_tree: release/v1.0.0-rc.1 candidate at commit 1c98bc34dc1a81a1a64e563ffe12bc13549e5442 (git tree 470b58c8e696d16b5f2966aec319096f6a4cb786; Harness2 removal and security remediation applied). The source content is bit-identical to the audited pre-rename candidate: the rc.1 relabel commit changes documentation, labels, evidence paths and one Cube recipe comment only.

method.profile: scoped re-review proportional to a first release candidate; source-first, read-only
scope: cmd/factory, cmd/turn-executor (CLI, console server, doctor, resources)
internal/factory (worker, workflow, activities, validation, Temporal security, intake, review/control, artifacts, hardening)
internal/console (auth, throttle, static/SPA, handlers), internal/httpsecurity, internal/secretfile, internal/repository

internal/sandbox (+ cube provider), internal/agentharness, internal/turnexec, internal/verification, internal/threatmon, internal/notify, internal/inferencebudget, internal/factoryartifacts, internal/releaseinfo, internal/tomlx
activities: re-derivation of every open 2026-10-29 finding that touches shipped code against current source
delta review of commits since the 2026-10-29 baseline (eca328a6 security hardening, 89a28361 fixtures, efb1659c/051062b4 release refreshes)
trust-boundary grep/review: exec sites, TLS config, listen validation, file access, secret readers, request-derived paths, approval/control paths
compile and vet of the candidate tree (go build ./... , go vet ./... ); no project tests executed on the host
coverage_limits: Partial coverage: the complete six-phase hunt was not re-run for every package; unchanged packages inherit the 2026-10-29 review plus this re-verification of the trust-boundary-bearing files.
No dynamic exploitation or sandboxed proof-of-concept was produced; findings are source-grounded and labelled accordingly.
Compiled SPA bundle reviewed only through its source and build inputs.

prior_findings_disposition.title: --local-path accepted arbitrary host directories
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/repository/validate.go validateLocalPath + provider.Validate/prepareLocal enforce exact registered canonical path and re-check at host read; local_source_security_test.go regressions; SECURITY.md trust model matches source

prior_findings_disposition.title: Console loopback was documentation-only once a token was set
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/httpsecurity.ValidateListen shared by console and turn-executor: non-loopback plaintext refused, TLS required; --no-auth restricted to loopback; tests production_test.go/TestServeRefusesNoAuthOnNonLoopback

prior_findings_disposition.title: Console token file Lstat->ReadFile TOCTOU
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/secretfile.Read opens with O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK, fstat + SameFile check and owner-only mode check; used by console token, TLS key, Temporal keyring/client key, credentials

prior_findings_disposition.title: Legacy binary_source staging allows host binary without digest
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/agentharness/generic.go still permits non-preinstalled BinarySource without binary_sha256; operator config-trusted, sandbox-only effect; preinstalled production path requires digest. Recorded residual, not Critical/High.

prior_findings_disposition.title: Throttle X-Forwarded-For first element client-controlled behind append proxy
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/console/throttle.go trusts XFF only for loopback TCP peers; documented deployment uses loopback proxy; >=32-char bearer token and pre-auth throttling bound impact; unchanged, recorded residual.

prior_findings_disposition.title: turn-executor --listen had no loopback/TLS gate in code
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: cmd/turn-executor/main.go now loads TLS via httpsecurity.LoadTLSConfig and calls httpsecurity.ValidateListen before and after listen; native HTTPS tests in cmd/turn-executor/main_test.go

prior_findings_disposition.title: Temporal client key / payload keyring read with no private-mode check
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/factory/temporal_security.go and payload_codec.go use secretfile.Read (owner-only, bounded, symlink-refusing); payload_codec_permissions_test.go regression

prior_findings_disposition.title: Unauthenticated /api/v1/console/healthz discloses version + server time
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/console/handlers.go:31-33 unchanged; reachable only where the console is served (loopback/TLS); no credential or task data. Recorded Info residual.

prior_findings_disposition.title: turnexec spec_sha is caller-asserted and not verified against stored content
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: internal/turnexec/service.go validates spec_sha format and echoes it in the result; profile_sha/policy_sha remain digest-verified. Recorded metadata-only residual.

prior_findings_disposition.title: Runtime/platform exposure (Cube management API, LAN listeners, unauthenticated Temporal)
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: Not source defects in the release artifact; deployment posture unchanged and owned by the operator/platform. Not claimed as resolved by this release; remains an inherited platform deployment gate (documented in the prior review).

prior_findings_disposition.title: Cube service credentials readable at rest / journaled
prior_findings_disposition.evidence: Host platform configuration, not ESF-shipped code; owner operator/platform; unchanged and recorded as inherited deployment risk.

new_observations.title: Cube recipe now rebuilds vendor payloads from source
new_observations.note: deploy/cube/Dockerfile rebuilds envd and the Unreal runner with the pinned Go 1.27.3 toolchain. Provenance, source-archive checksums and resulting binary digests are pinned in-recipe; template lifecycle revalidated (create/exec/destroy, doctor, agent digest verify). Risk: if a rebuilt envd regresses Cube lifecycle compatibility, revert the stage to the vendor payload and record inherited platform risk. Rollback template tpl-4ae712b3f614434a90959a81 retained.

new_observations.title: Intake image no longer ships a distribution Python
new_observations.note: Runtime is pinned Alpine plus a uv-managed CPython 3.15.2; uv.lock closure unchanged and installed with --locked. Reduces OS package surface to empty for python packages and removes 62 High Debian wont-fix findings. Reproducibility is bound by the pinned Alpine digest and uv version; the interpreter download is version-pinned and verified by uv.

new_observations.title: Unreal runner in-template payload differs from operator install pin
new_observations.note: The template ships the Go 1.27.3 rebuild (sha256 056c3492...) while scripts/install-agents.sh keeps verifying the upstream release binary (d289aa20...). Both are intentional and must stay documented; operators enabling the commented example harness config with preinstalled=true must use the rebuilt digest.

verdict: No source-grounded Critical or High finding in the shipped Go surface at 1.0.0-rc.1. All three prior High findings were runtime/platform posture items outside the source artifact; all shipped-code prior findings assessed Medium or lower are either fixed with regression coverage (S-01/S-02/S-03/S-06/S-07) or remain accepted Low/Info residuals (S-04/S-05/S-12/S-14) with no boundary crossing demonstrated.
